result.summary: Found 3 issues: a broken image placeholder in the 'Popular right now' section, a cut-off restaurant card at the right edge of 'Fastest near you', and inconsistent image loading between sections.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in 'Popular right now' shows a broken/missing image placeholder icon instead of an actual restaurant image
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image asset loads correctly or provide a fallback image; check API/image URL for this restaurant listing

issues.description: The third restaurant card (Trattoria Piccol...) in 'Fastest near you' is cut off at the edge of the screen, with its name truncated
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal scroll padding or card sizing so the last visible card is either fully shown or clearly indicates more content via a partial peek with proper spacing

issues.description: Inconsistent visual treatment between cards with broken image placeholder and cards with fully rendered images/icons in the same horizontal scroll list
issues.suggestion: Standardize image loading states with skeleton loaders or consistent placeholder styling while content loads
